notes: Present from 9.7; absent from 9.0 builds (live introspection, 2026-10-24).

functions.name: component_id
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the ID of Structure component id.

functions.name: density
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the density of Structure elements.

functions.name: extra
functions.signature: itasca.structure.selarray.extra(slot: int) -> array float{Structure} or float{Structure,3}
functions.description: Get the Structure extra data in the given slot as an array. Extra variables accessed by array must be of type float or vec.

functions.name: id
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the ID of Structure element id.

functions.name: in_group
functions.description: Return Structure group membership as a Boolean array.

functions.name: local_system
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the local coordinate system of Structure elements.

functions.name: mark
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the mark flag of Structure elements.

functions.name: pos
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the current position of Structure elements.

functions.name: set_density
functions.description: Set the density of Structure elements.

functions.name: set_extra
functions.signature: itasca.structure.selarray.set_extra(slot: int, data: array float{Structure} or float{Structure, 3}) -> None
functions.description: Set the Structure extra data in the given slot with an array. Extra variables set by array must be of type float or vec.

functions.name: set_group
functions.signature: itasca.structure.selarray.set_group(membership: array bool{Structure}, group_name: str, slot=1) -> None
functions.description: Set Structure group from an array. Where membership True set the corresponding Structure to be a member of group group_name in the given slot.

functions.name: set_mark
functions.description: Set the mark flag of Structure elements.

functions.name: set_thermal_expansion
functions.description: Set the thermal expansion coefficient of Structure elements.

functions.name: thermal_expansion
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the thermal expansion coefficient of Structure elements.

functions.name: type
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the type name of Structure elements.
